name: cyberpunk
description: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners / Night City sunset: electric blue skies, hot-pink horizons, purple shadows.
notes: Sliders copied one-for-one from a Lightroom tutorial. It also used a sky mask (Exposure +0.05, Contrast +6, Highlights -28, Shadows +10, Whites +4, Blacks -3) that looks doesn't support yet, and its example photos were taken darker and bluer per photo. Pull Exposure down and Temp cooler for a deeper night look.
